title: DraftKings CEO 回应预测市场投入加大
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Shares of Draft Kings plunging on a 2027 earnings forecast that missed estimates investors also not happy with third quarter revenue And a cut outlook for the fiscal year 2026 shows down about 26% right now
segments.zh: DraftKings股价暴跌，因其2027年盈利预测不及预期，市场参与者也对第三季度营收不满，且2026财年展望下调，目前股价下跌约26%。

segments.en: We're joined by the CEO of Draft Kings Jason Robbins Jason to me. This was all about prediction markets Not in the sense of competition, but in the sense of stepped up investment in what you're doing with prediction markets
segments.zh: DraftKings CEO Jason Robbins与我们同在。Jason，在我看来，这一切都关乎预测市场，不是竞争层面，而是你们在预测市场上的投入加大。

segments.en: You said 650 to 700 million dollars as a result of this why are prediction markets so expensive for you to build out?
segments.zh: 你说这会带来6.5亿到7亿美元的成本，为什么预测市场对你来说建设成本如此高昂？

segments.en: Well, it's not the build out. We actually built out I think what is now the best-in-class sports offering For much less we most of that was marketing investment to acquire customers
segments.zh: 嗯，不是建设成本。我们实际上以低得多的成本打造了目前业内一流的体育产品，大部分支出是用于获取客户的营销投入。

segments.en: We had unbelievable customer acquisition paybacks with the cohort we acquired so far this year So we leaned in and I mean this was one where we messaged that we we were gonna follow the data and spend more
segments.zh: 今年迄今我们获取的客户群带来了惊人的客户获取回报，所以我们加大了投入，这是一个我们曾表示会跟随数据、增加支出的案例。

segments.en: I think it was a lot more than people thought there was some sticker shock I do think if you look at our earnings materials we put disclosed a lot of data on the paybacks and
segments.zh: 我认为这比人们预想的要多得多，有些让人瞠目结舌。如果你看我们的收益材料，我们披露了大量关于回报和这些**回报率的数据。

segments.en: What the returns on those investments are and they look extremely attractive So I think once you know that dust settles and we start to be able to show that that people will see it was a good investment
segments.zh: 这些**回报看起来极具吸引力。所以我认为一旦尘埃落定，我们开始能够展示这一点，人们就会看到这是一笔好**。

segments.en: But there was certainly a reaction to the short term and I understand that But you know, I think this will prove to be the the right move for us over the next year or two
segments.zh: 但短期确实有反应，我理解。不过我认为未来一两年这将被证明是对我们正确的举措。

segments.en: Just a few months ago you expected to invest only 200 to 300 million In predictions this year
segments.zh: 就在几个月前，你还预计今年在预测市场上只投入2亿到3亿美元。
